mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an easing monetary policy, reducing the discount rate for equity valuation and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1% in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 5.0% signals a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE is below 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in real GDP growth (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) above 11500 and 1000 respectively indicates robust economic expansion, driving corporate profit growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when both GDPC1 and HOUST exceed 11500 and 1000 respectively.

mechanism_narrative: During economic expansion phases (indicated by industrial production growth above 110), the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day forward returns due to rising corporate profits, while the signal reverses in contraction phases.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO exceeds 110.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) over the prior month signals strong consumer demand, driving corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS increases by at least 0.5% in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI exceeds 2.5%, it signals inflationary pressures that prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals strong monetary and labor market stimulus, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when both FEDFUNDS and UNRATE decline by at least 0.1% in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: During economic contraction phases (indicated by industrial production growth below 105), the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day forward returns due to declining corporate earnings, while the signal reverses in expansion phases.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO falls below 105.
